turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I changed the prompts that write the end-of-meeting recap so they keep tasks that have a person on them but no deadline. I haven't run a real meeting through it, so I haven't confirmed the model now includes them.

**Cause:** nothing in the code removes action items after the AI writes them. The problem was in the instructions sent to the model. The prompts for live notes already say to keep tasks with no deadline, but the recap prompts never did. The backup prompt used for the Groq service (`electron/llm/prompts.ts`) also showed only one example item, and it had a deadline ("Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday"). That nudged the model to list only tasks with dates.

**Changes:**
- **`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`**: added a rule to the recap instructions: keep every task that has an owner, write "(no date given)" when there's no deadline, and never invent a date. This rule also applies when a meeting mode uses its own custom sections. I also changed the action-items description in the default recap to ask for that format.
- **`electron/llm/prompts.ts`**: added the same rule to the Groq recap prompt, and gave it a second example with no date: `"Priya: Send the contract (no date given)"`.

Your example should now appear as **"Priya: Send the contract (no date given)"**.

**Separate bug I noticed:** the Groq prompt asks for the overview under the name `summary`, but `MeetingPersistence.ts` reads it from `overview`. So when Groq writes the recap, the overview is probably missing. I can fix that too if you want.

I made a second fix that should cover the main case my first one missed, but I couldn't test it. I couldn't type-check it either: TypeScript isn't installed in the project, and the sandbox blocked downloading it.

**Why the first fix wasn't enough:** when a meeting mode like Team Meet is active, the recap is built from that mode's sections, using the descriptions saved with your mode. Team Meet's action-items section says *"All action items that were said **I** would do after the meeting."* So "Priya will send the contract" was left out because the task belongs to Priya, not you. The general rule I added before was too weak to override that.

**What I changed:** in `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`, any section whose title looks like action items, follow-ups or next steps now gets an extra instruction added when the prompt is built. It tells the model to:
- write each item as `Owner: task (due date)`
- include tasks for **any** participant, not just you
- keep tasks with no deadline and write "(no date given)" instead
- never invent a date

Because this is added when the prompt is built, it also covers modes you've already saved.

**Two things to check:**
- **Rebuild and restart the app.** These files run in the app's background process, so a running copy keeps the old prompts until you restart it.
- **Sales and Recruiting modes are affected too.** Their action-items sections were also written to cover only your own tasks. With this change they'll list everyone's tasks as well. If you'd rather keep those two to your own tasks, I can limit the "any participant" part to Team Meet and the general recap.

If it still drops the item after a restart, send me the console line that starts with `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response`. It shows whether the model left the task out or something later removed it.

I made a third fix, but this round is partly a guess. I still don't know why the item is missing in your case, and nothing has been tested against a real meeting. I couldn't type-check the code either, since TypeScript isn't installed and the sandbox blocked the download.

**What I found:** two places drop meeting content before the AI ever sees it, so no prompt wording could fix them.

1. **Only the start of the meeting was sent.** The recap used just the first 10,000 characters of the transcript, roughly the first 15–20 minutes. A task assigned near the end, like "Priya will send the contract", was cut off. Tasks agreed at the end often have no date, so this may be why it looked tied to deadlines.
   - **Fix** in `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`: it now sends up to 60,000 characters. If a meeting is longer, it keeps the first 10,000 plus the most recent 50,000, and logs a warning that the middle was left out.
2. **In very long meetings, earlier parts are compressed.** Older transcript is shrunk to 3–5 bullets, and that step was never asked to keep action items.
   - **Fix** in `electron/SessionTracker.ts`: that step now also lists every task as `Action: Owner: task (due date)`, with "(no date given)" when there's no date.

**What I need from you:** rebuild and restart the app, end a test meeting where someone says "Priya will send the contract", then tell me:
- Is a mode active, like Team Meet, or is it the plain recap?
- Roughly how long was the meeting, and when in it was the task said?
- The console line starting with `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response`.

That line shows the AI's raw answer before anything else runs. If the task is in it, the problem is in how the recap is saved or shown. If it isn't, the problem is in what the AI was given.
